plan.summary:
The PR changes snapshot identity from a bare UUID to a project-scoped `SnapshotKey`. It also changes the flush decision.

- `stale` returns `SnapshotKey` values and now treats entries that expire exactly at `now` as stale.
- `shouldFlush` now returns true when `force` is set, even with no pending items.
plan.riskRationale: Changes to a return type and an expiry boundary affect data lifecycle in snapshots. The flush change is small. No tests appear in the diff.
plan.storyArc: Two independent changes. First, snapshots are keyed by project and expire at the boundary. Second, flushing can now be forced.

topics.title: Snapshot keys and expiry boundary in stale()
topics.narrativeBrief: What does stale() return now, and when is an entry stale? Verify that callers accept SnapshotKey, and that `<=` is intended, so entries expiring at `now` are included.

topics.title: Forced flush in shouldFlush
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `force` change the flush decision? Verify that the old code ignored `force`, and check callers that pass it.
